datasets.name: Bijie Landslide Dataset
datasets.verbatim: we conducted comparative experiments using the publicly available Bijie Landslide Dataset [23].

datasets.name: WHU building dataset
datasets.verbatim: all models were trained on the WHU building dataset [73] and fine-tuned on the Bijie landslide dataset.

methods.name: CNN-based landslide extraction method that integrates both local and nonlocal features
methods.summary: A CNN-based landslide extraction model that fuses local features (via LFEM) and nonlocal features (via NFEM) to capture both global contextual semantic information and landslide boundary structures, combined with a post-training quantization technique to convert the model from FP32 to INT8 for embedded deployment.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked, and the custom CNN-based method code is not available via any repository or persistent link.
